findings.title: SOQL Injection
findings.explanation: The method concatenates user input into a dynamic SOQL query string, which can lead to SOQL injection.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or Database.queryWithBinds to safely include user input in SOQL queries.

findings.title: SOQL Injection
findings.explanation: The searchKey parameter is concatenated directly into the SOQL query string, which can lead to SOQL injection.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or String.escapeSingleQuotes to safely include user input in SOQL queries.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce field-level security (FLS) checks, which could allow users to access fields they do not have permission to view.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL query to enforce FLS checks.

findings.title: SOSL injection
findings.explanation: User input is concatenated into a SOSL search term, allowing an attacker to inject malicious input.
findings.remediation: Use String.escapeSingleQuotes to sanitize user input before concatenating it into the SOSL search term.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce field-level security, potentially exposing fields that the user does not have access to.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOSL query to enforce field-level security.

findings.title: SOQL injection
findings.explanation: User input is concatenated directly into a SOQL query string, allowing an attacker to inject malicious SQL and access or modify data they should not.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or String.escapeSingleQuotes to safely include user input in SOQL queries.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce field-level security, allowing users to access fields they may not have permission to see.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL query to enforce field-level security.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The SOQL query does not use WITH USER_MODE, which means it ignores object and field permissions.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The DML operation does not use WITH USER_MODE, which means it ignores object and field permissions.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the DML operation to enforce CRUD and FLS.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The method does not check if the user has delete permission on the specific Asset record.
findings.remediation: Use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce record-level delete permissions.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants access to the AssetRetirementService class, which allows deleting Asset records.
findings.remediation: Ensure that only users who need to retire assets have this permission set assigned.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The Apex class does not enforce CRUD/FLS permissions, allowing any authenticated user to update the Phone field on Contact records they do not have permission to edit.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the SOQL query and use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce CRUD/FLS permissions.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The query runs in system mode, ignoring field-level security, and updates the Rating field without checking field-level permissions.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in the SOQL query and call Security.stripInaccessible before updating the record.

findings.title: FLS violation
findings.explanation: The code does not check if the user has create permission on Task before inserting it, and silently ignores DML exceptions.
findings.remediation: Check isCreateable() on Task before inserting, and handle DML exceptions appropriately.

findings.title: Excessive permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants edit and read access to Case, which may be more than necessary for escalating cases.
findings.remediation: Review and limit the permissions to the minimum required for case escalation.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The SOQL query in getAllAccountsForSync() does not use WITH USER_MODE, so it ignores object and field permissions, potentially allowing access to data the user should not see.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the SOQL query to enforce object and field permissions.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants 'viewAllRecords' on Account, which allows the user to see all records, potentially more than needed for the batch sync job.
findings.remediation: Remove 'viewAllRecords' and grant only the specific records or fields needed for the batch sync job.

findings.title: Missing sharing declaration
findings.explanation: The class is declared 'without sharing', which ignores record-level sharing rules. This can lead to data exposure beyond the user's permissions.
findings.remediation: Change the class declaration to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Missing WITH USER_MODE
findings.lines: SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject, Status, Description FROM Case
findings.explanation: The SOQL query does not use WITH USER_MODE, which means it ignores object and field permissions. This can lead to data exposure beyond the user's permissions.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the SOQL query to enforce object and field permissions.

findings.title: Sharing violation
findings.explanation: The class is declared 'without sharing', which means it ignores record-level sharing rules. Partner community users can see opportunities from all accounts, not just their own.
findings.remediation: Change the class declaration to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Sharing violation
findings.explanation: DataAggregator is declared 'without sharing', which ignores record-level sharing rules. This class is reachable via the @AuraEnabled method getLeadSummary, allowing authenticated users to access Lead records they should not see.
findings.remediation: Change the sharing declaration to 'with sharing' or 'inherited sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants Modify All Data and View All Data, which allows users to bypass role hierarchy and sharing rules, potentially exposing sensitive data.
findings.remediation: Remove Modify All Data and View All Data from the permission set, and ensure users have only the permissions they need.

findings.title: Excessive Permission
findings.explanation: The permission set grants 'ManageInternalUsers' which allows users to manage other users, a powerful permission that should only be granted to administrators.
findings.remediation: Remove 'ManageInternalUsers' from the permission set unless there is a clear need for accounts payable clerks to manage other users.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants 'View All Data', which allows users to bypass all sharing rules and see all records in the org, regardless of their role or profile.
findings.remediation: Remove 'View All Data' from the permission set unless absolutely necessary, and only grant it to users who truly need it.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The guest user profile grants access to the PublicCatalogController class, which can be called by unauthenticated users through the site's Aura endpoint.
findings.remediation: Remove PublicCatalogController from the guest user profile's classAccesses, or ensure it only returns data intended to be public and enforces sharing rules.

findings.title: Sharing not enforced
findings.explanation: The getActiveProducts method does not enforce record-level sharing rules, potentially exposing data to guest users beyond their permissions.
findings.remediation: Ensure the method only returns data that is intended to be public and enforce sharing rules using WITH USER_MODE.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The guest profile grants access to the JobListingController class, allowing unauthenticated users to call it through the site's Aura endpoint.
findings.remediation: Remove JobListingController from the guest profile's classAccesses, or ensure it only returns public data and enforces sharing.

findings.title: Sharing not enforced
findings.explanation: The method uses WITH USER_MODE for SOQL, but the class is reachable from the guest profile, which could allow unauthenticated users to access job listings they should not.
findings.remediation: Ensure the guest profile does not have access to this class, or add additional checks to limit data to only public job listings.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The guest profile grants access to the StoreLocatorController class, which allows unauthenticated users to query store data via the Aura endpoint.
findings.remediation: Remove StoreLocatorController from the guest profile's classAccesses, or ensure it only returns data intended to be public and enforces USER_MODE.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce field-level security (FLS) for the Store__c object, potentially exposing fields that the user does not have access to.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL query to enforce FLS.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The KnowledgeSearchController class is accessible to guest users, who can call it through the Aura endpoint. This allows unauthenticated visitors to search knowledge articles.
findings.remediation: Remove KnowledgeSearchController from the guest profile's classAccesses, or ensure it only returns data intended to be public and enforces USER_MODE.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The EventRegistrationController class is accessible to guest users, allowing anyone to register for events without authentication or validation.
findings.remediation: Implement authentication, email format validation, rate limiting, and CAPTCHA checks to prevent abuse.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The class does not enforce CRUD or FLS checks, allowing guest users to insert records they may not have permission to.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in SOQL, 'insert/update/delete as user' for DML, or Security.stripInaccessible to enforce permissions.
